Kejriwal, Banerjee demand CEC Gyanesh Kumar's arrest, fresh Bengal polls

Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has called for the arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the cancellation of elections in Delhi and other places. West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has also demanded the arrest of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and fresh elections in Bengal, accusing the Election Commission and the BJP.
